newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH PARLIAMENT TO DEBATE ERM, EMU ON OCT 10.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH PARLIAMENT TO DEBATE ERM, EMU ON OCT 10.

text.p: Parliament will debate issues relating to Europe's Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) and Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) at Thursday's question and answer session with cabinet ministers.

In a statement received on Wednesday, parliament said four of the five questions accepted by the speakers' council for the Q & A session due to start on October 10 at 1630 (1330 GMT) dealt with EMU and ERM.
The first two questions -- about progress made at the EU's inter-governmental conference (IGC) and about the EU's economic and employment policies -- will be answered at the same time.

A combined answer by a cabinet minister will also be given to questions three and four -- about the economic effects of EMU and about whether linking the markka to ERM is necessary, the parliament statement said.
A brief open debate on each topic usually follows the formal response by a government representative.
Both Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen and Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto are due to be present at the session, government officials said.
